core_memory.diabetes_treatment: Type 2 Diabetes: Currently on metformin 1000 mg twice daily. A1C around 6.9%. Doctor suggested adding semaglutide(Ozempic) at a low dose to improve blood sugar control and appetite management. Fasting blood sugar typically ranges between 125-130 mg/dL.
core_memory.hypertension_treatment: High Blood Pressure: Currently on losartan 50 mg once daily. Blood pressure readings typically range from 135-140/80-90 mmHg. Doctor recommends stress management and reducing sodium intake instead of increasing dosage. Taking a daily magnesium supplement, which may support blood pressure regulation.
core_memory.hypothyroidism_treatment: Hypothyroidism: On levothyroxine 75 mcg once daily. Taken on an empty stomach, at least 30 minutes before eating. Last TSH test result: 2.1 mIU/L(within normal range). No dosage changes needed. Noticeable sluggishness if a dose is missed; uses a pill organizer to stay on track.
core_memory.osteoarthritis_treatment: Osteoarthritis: Uses acetaminophen as needed for mild pain. Takes meloxicam 7.5 mg when joints are particularly stiff(knees and hands), but only intermittently to avoid overuse of NSAIDs. Doctor recommended glucosamine supplements; effect on symptoms is uncertain and not yet confirmed.
core_memory.vitamin_d_and_bone_health: Vitamin D3 2,000 IU daily(levels were 22 ng/mL; target >30). Taking calcium for early osteopenia. Doctor recommends combining with vitamin K2 for better absorption and bone health.
core_memory.cholesterol_treatment: Statin therapy: Taking atorvastatin 10 mg daily. Initial LDL: 130 mg/dL, triglycerides: 140 mg/dL. Doctor prescribed low-dose statin to improve lipid profile. Cholesterol levels have improved, and no side effects reported(e.g., muscle aches).
core_memory.medication_interactions_precautions: Avoid frequent NSAID use(e.g., meloxicam) with losartan due to kidney risk. Take levothyroxine separately from calcium/iron. Combine vitamin D3, calcium with K2 for bone health.
